:::{#def-mean}
#### Mean (average, sample mean)

The **mean** (or **average**) of $n$ numbers $y_1, \ldots, y_n$ is
their [sum](algebra.qmd#def-summation) divided by how many there are:

$$\bar{y} \eqdef \frac{1}{n} \sumin y_i$$

When the numbers are observed data values,
$\bar{y}$ is also called the **sample mean**.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-mean}
#### The mean of three numbers

For $y_1 = 2$, $y_2 = -1$ and $y_3 = 5$:

$$
\ba
\bar{y}
&= \frac{1}{3}\,\paren{2 + (-1) + 5}
&& \text{(definition of the mean, with } n = 3 \text{)}
\\
&= \frac{1}{3} \cd 6
&& \text{(add)}
\\
&= 2
&& \text{(multiply)}
\ea
$$

:::
